messages:
sarah: Hey team — thinking about a Friday night ramen run + mini trivia afterwards. Bus from office at 6pm? :ramen: :bus:

mike: I'm in. can help coordinate the bus seats. how many? :+1:

elaine: Count me but I need a veg option. any place with veggie broth?

parth: 2 spots for me and a +1. can we do a quick poll for pickup stops?

alex: I might need to leave early around 7:20 — can we aim for a 6:10 depart?

devon: I can handle music/quiz questions. want 10 quick rounds (pop culture + nonsense facts)? :game_die:

janet: FYI I'll chip in $5 for the bus. Venmo @janet. Is the bus cash ok too?

mike: Bus fee $5 cash or Venmo @mike — I'll collect. route idea: Office lobby -> 5th & main pickup -> Pier 3 drop. propose leaving 6:10 if that helps alex.

elaine: 6:10 works for me. also pls check accessibility for the ramen spot (ramen shop has a few steps maybe).

hr-bot: Reminder: team social budgets can cover up to $15 per person for offsite team-building. If you want reimbursement, submit expense within 30 days with attendee list. :receipt:

parth: @sarah can you post quick poll with stops? I'll RSVP +1 once I see it.

sarah: Sure — quick poll: A) lobby only, B) lobby + 5th & Main, C) lobby + 5th + Pier 3. React with :one:, :two:, :three:.

mike: Voting :two: (lobby + 5th & Main)

devon: Voting :two: and I'll bring a short quiz schedule. thinking 6 questions per round, 5 rounds, prizes = ramen coupons.

janet: Voting :one: (just lobby) — easier for me.

elaine: :two: for me (5th & Main helps).

alex: :two: — thanks for accommodating my timing.

sarah: Looks like :two: wins. Plan: meet in lobby 6:00, bus departs 6:10, ramen at 6:35, trivia at 8:00 at the back table. Bring $5 for bus or Venmo @mike before Friday noon.

mike: I'll post a short signup sheet with seat numbers. reply with seat prefs (window/aisle).

devon: Also planning a silly tiebreaker question involving emoji charades. prepare your best :ramen: impressions.

sarah: sweet. tagging logistics folks: @office-ops can we secure a little back table for ~15?

office-ops: (automated) Noted — reserving back table, will confirm by Thursday EOD.

mike: final RSVP list so far: sarah, mike, elaine, parth (+1), alex, devon, janet = 8 people (+1). anyone else?

sam: i'll join last minute if spots left, otherwise maybe next time. :wave:

sarah: awesome — will update the signup. see y'all Friday! :sparkles:
